tags.reasoning: The visionary city, with its gates named after the tribes and the presence of God (Jehovah-Shammah), is frequently interpreted as a type of the eschatological New Jerusalem described in Revelation 21. Proposed by: Christopher J. H. Wright, The Message of Ezekiel, 2001.
